title: Western
story: Saddle up for a sunny day in a frontier town.

cards.name: Cowboy Hat
cards.subject: A cowboy hat with a tall creased crown, a wide brim curled up at both sides and a band around the base of the crown.
cards.hero_colors: tan brown with a red band

cards.name: Cactus
cards.subject: A tall green saguaro cactus with a ribbed trunk, two arms curving upward and a small yellow flower on top of the trunk.

cards.name: Harmonica
cards.subject: A harmonica: a long silver rectangle with a row of small square holes along the front, curved cover plates at both ends and two gold screws.

cards.name: Cowboy Boots
cards.subject: A pair of brown leather cowboy boots with tall shafts, pointed toes, angled heels and a star stitched on each shaft.

cards.name: Saloon Doors
cards.subject: A pair of swinging half-height saloon doors with slatted louvres, hinged to a wooden door frame set in a wooden wall, with open gaps above and below the doors.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown with red trim on the frame
cards.surface_or_setting: the doorway in the wooden front wall of a saloon

cards.name: Lasso
cards.subject: A lasso: a coiled rope ending in a wide open loop with a sliding knot, and a red cloth tied around the knot.
cards.hero_colors: tan rope with a red cloth

cards.name: Wagon
cards.subject: A covered wagon with a wooden box body, four wooden wheels, an arched white canvas cover and a wooden pole at the front.
cards.hero_colors: white canvas and wood brown with a red stripe on the canvas

cards.name: Horseshoe
cards.subject: A symmetrical silver steel horseshoe lying flat, U-shaped with the open end at the top and six nail holes along the curve, each holding a brass nail.

cards.name: Campfire
cards.subject: A bright fire with a yellow-white glowing core, orange flame tips curling upward, glowing orange ends on the logs, and warm orange light cast on what stands near it; the logs sit in a ring of grey stones, with a black tin coffee pot on a flat stone beside it.
cards.hero_colors: orange flames, dark wood logs, black coffee pot, grey stones
cards.surface_or_setting: a patch of dry dirt with a ring of stones

cards.name: Hat Tip
cards.subject: The man in a cowboy hat tips it politely outside a saloon while the pig beside him proudly wears a matching hat that sits between its big ears.
cards.hero_colors: tan brown hats, pink pig, brown mustache, red neckerchief
cards.surface_or_setting: a dusty street in front of a wooden saloon wall
